test_title: PYST 43: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’ and

P % Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

How is D related to W if ‘D & E # F % L & W’?
solution:

Given: D & E # F % L & W

It means: D is the brother of E, E is the sister of F, F is the father of L, L is the brother of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da31a279f07865c3c7d0b8a32d10efc75bff141523c779b38b01cabd39cd9f93.png] 

Thus, D is W's Father's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
